cohort: The study included 568 nulliparous women with Type 1 diabetes and 910 nulliparous women with Type 2 diabetes who had singleton births in New South Wales, Australia, between 2016 and 2020.
finding: Women with Type 1 diabetes had higher odds of adverse perinatal outcomes compared to those with Type 2 diabetes, and obesity specifically increased the risk of adverse outcomes in women with Type 2 diabetes but not Type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Women with Type 1 diabetes had higher odds of caesarean section, and obesity conferred an increased odds of caesarean section in women with Type 2 diabetes.
